notes: Positive: explicit splitting requests across work-item types (story / task / bug / spike / chore / enabler), named techniques (SPIDR / Lawrence / Hamburger / Carpaccio), Spanish triggers. Negative: implement code, write the PRD, full development plan, code review, ADR authoring. Edge: spike-only task that should not be split further; story that already passes INVEST.
